messages:
Maria (AE): Quick heads-up — kickoff with MerchantCo trial tomorrow 10am PT. Need alignment on success criteria + eval harness before that.
Derek (Solutions): Copy. Main asks from my side: use-case scope, golden prompt set, scoring weights, regression gates, timeline. I made a quick draft below.
Maria (AE): Sharing draft now — please keep it tight, exec will ask for the "why" on each metric. @Nisha can you confirm security questionnaire status? @Kevin FYI.
Derek (Solutions): Draft (high level):
- Use cases: customer support triage (primary), order summarization (secondary), fraud-flag suggestions (stretch).
- Golden prompts: 30 anchors total (15 support, 10 summarization, 5 fraud).
- Scoring: correctness (0-2), safety/compliance (0-1), latency penalty (0-1). Weighted score = 0.6*correctness + 0.3*safety + 0.1*latency.
- Regression gate: new model must not drop >3% weighted score vs baseline on goldens.
- Timeline: 2-week hands-on eval (week 1 ingest/prompts + run, week 2 regressions + hand review).
Nisha (Solutions): This looks good. Two notes: MerchantCo wants data redaction checks in the harness (PII masking) and a simple CLI to run evaluations locally.
Kevin (Security): On questionnaire: they submitted a standard vendor security form — we flagged data residency (they require EU-only processing) and encryption-at-rest key control. For trial we'll use token redaction + demo dataset (no live PII). Full Private deployment will be discussed post-trial.
Olivia (CS): For onboarding: 3 days to get baseline prompts in, then automated scoring runs every 12h. I recommend adding 20 adversarial examples per use case to test failure modes.
Derek (Solutions): Agree. Add adversarial set. Also propose a tiny scorer snippet we can drop into their harness:
```python
# simple scorer: 2 exact, 1 fuzzy, 0 fail
from difflib import SequenceMatcher

def score(pred, gold):
    if pred.strip() == gold.strip():
        return 2
    ratio = SequenceMatcher(None, pred, gold).ratio()
    return 1 if ratio > 0.6 else 0

# weighted aggregation example
weighted = 0.6*correctness + 0.3*safety + 0.1*latency
```
Maria (AE): Pricing question from the customer: can we offer a short dedicated capacity trial? They want predictable latency at scale. What are the guardrails?
Derek (Solutions): We can offer a 2-week Dedicated eval with limited GPUs as a paid pilot. Need legal + finance sign-off. For the hosted trial, we should estimate token burn — run the harness with sample volumes to give a cost estimate.
Nisha (Solutions): I'll add an estimator job to the harness to report projected monthly cost at their QPS.
Kevin (Security): For the trial pitch, call out: no live customer data, EU region only, KMS-managed keys for artifacts, and audit logging enabled. That addresses most of their compliance checklist.
Olivia (CS): Success gates suggestion (customer-facing):
- Gate A (baseline green): average weighted score >= 0.75 across support use cases + median latency < 350ms for 95th percentile.
- Gate B (stretch): automated routing reduction >= 30% (fewer tickets escalated).
- Blocker gate: any safety breach (PII leakage or hallucinated legal advice) -> stop and triage.
Maria (AE): Great. Action items:
- @Derek: finalize harness + add CLI + estimator (EOD today).
- @Nisha: confirm vendor security Q responses and incorporate Kevin's redaction constraints (tomorrow AM).
- @Kevin: draft short note for the customer describing data controls (today).
- @Olivia: prepare onboarding checklist + 20 adversarial prompts (tomorrow).
I'll present these at kickoff and call out the regression gate and pricing options.
deploy-bot: infra check for sandbox cluster: all nodes ready in eu-west-1 :white_check_mark:
Maria (AE): Perfect — thanks team. I'll sync with Legal on Dedicated trial contract after kickoff. :thumbsup:
